profile_name: Plans off — the formula baseline for PM-10
description: Sets PLANS_ENABLED to 0, which is the single gate every plan consumer sits behind: deployment order and per-model placement (PM-2a), formations reserves/embarkations/attachments (PM-2b) and earmark bias (PM-3) all check it. Loaded on the BASELINE arm of the PM-10 paired A/B so both arms are handed the same plan file and differ only in whether the AI is allowed to read it. Holding the plan constant and varying the gate — rather than passing the plan to one arm only — keeps everything else about the two arms byte-identical.
